footprint.notes: Adobe publishes no state or per-country headcounts. The FY2025 10-K gives employees only as U.S. vs. international (50/50 of 31,360 at Nov 28, 2025). Workspace shares (U.S. 62% / India 23% / rest of world 14%, FY2024; sums to 99% as printed) come from the 2024 CSR report's data tables; no newer edition found (checked 2026-11-24: Adobe's corporate responsibility reports page lists the 2024 Metrics and Indicators report as the latest, plus a 2026 CDP response and an FY2025 GHG assurance letter, which are not the same kind of report), so those rows keep their FY2024 period. The U.S. appears twice in 'countries', once per metric, because the employee share comes from the 10-K and the workspace share from the CSR report. The CSR PDF on adobe.com returns 403 (Akamai) to curl; in the earlier pass it was fetched through the WebFetch tool and read with pdftotext, so automated re-verification of the spaceShare rows and the Hillsboro site may hit the same block. Sites: San Jose HQ and the two Indian offices (Bangalore and Noida, each about 0.7 million sq ft) from FY2025 10-K Item 2; the owned Hillsboro, OR data center from the CSR environmental table. The 10-K's revenue-by-region shares (Americas/EMEA/APAC) are deliberately not repeated.
